## Problem statement

A settlement clerk loses two hours a night matching card settlements to the ledger by hand.

## Target user

Back-office settlement clerks at mid-size acquirers.
- Reconciles 400 to 900 settlement lines a night.
- Works from a bank export and an accounting export.

Finance leads at the same acquirers.
- Approves the write-offs a clerk cannot clear.
- Reads the exception list once a day, not once a night.

## Core flows

| ID | Actor | Trigger | Steps | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FLOW-001 | Settlement clerk | The nightly settlement file lands | Open the file -> upload it -> read the match count | Every settlement line is matched or flagged |
| FLOW-002 | Settlement clerk | The match run finishes | Open the exception list -> sort by amount -> pick a line | The clerk sees which lines have no ledger match |
| FLOW-003 | Finance lead | A line stays unmatched for two nights | Open the line -> read the history -> approve a write-off | The line leaves the exception list |

## Non-goals

This product excludes chargeback dispute handling.
This product excludes ledger posting.

## Success signal

Unmatched settlement lines at 09:00 | below 5 | one week
